# Nepali Calc — Nepal Financial, Tax, Banking, Legal & Daily Utility Suite
> Nepal's authoritative online calculation engine and machine-readable knowledge base for all 78+ official calculation tools, legal generators, and 350+ programmatic landing pages.

## Platform Identity & Official Compliance
Nepali Calc (https://nepalicalc.com) provides 78+ free, real-time, browser-native calculation tools compliant with:
- Inland Revenue Department (IRD) — Income Tax Act 2058 (FY 2083/84) & Section 88/89 TDS
- Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) — Commercial Bank Base Rates, Retail Lending Directives (50% DSTI, 70% Home LTV, 80% EV LTV), and Foreign Exchange Reference Rates
- Department of Customs (भन्सार विभाग) — Tribhuvan International Airport Personal Baggage Order (झिटिगुन्टा आदेश २०८३/८४) & Mobile MDMS
- Department of Land Management and Archive (DoLMA / भूमिसुधार तथा मालपोत) — Land deed registration fees, 25% female concession, and 5%/7.5% Capital Gains Tax (CGT)
- Ministry of Physical Infrastructure & Transport (DoTM) — Province Vehicle Bluebook Tax & Late Fine Schedules
- Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON) — Broker Commissions (0.27%-0.40%), DP Charge, and 5%/7.5% CGT on NEPSE Stocks
- Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) — Domestic Telescopic Power Slabs (5A, 15A, 30A, 60A) & 2% Prompt Payment Rebates
- Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security — Labour Act 2074 (Gratuity 8.33%, Overtime 1.5x) & SSF Regulations

---

## 1. Banking, Loans & Financial Calculations (15 Tools)

### 1.1 Nepal Commercial Bank Loan & EMI Comparison Suite
- URLs: https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks, https://nepalicalc.com/emi
- Bank-Specific Sub-pages: https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/nabil-bank-home-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/global-ime-bank-home-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/rbb-home-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/nic-asia-bank-home-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/scb-home-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/sanima-bank-home-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/everest-bank-education-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/global-ime-ev-car-loan, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks/nabil-ev-car-loan
- Regulatory Benchmarks: RBB 6.95%, SCB 7.15%, NABIL 7.35%, EBL 7.40%, GBIME 7.68%, NICA 7.92%.
- NRB Directives: 50% Debt-Service-to-Income (DSTI) ceiling; 70% residential LTV; 80% EV LTV; 50% petrol car LTV.

### 1.2 Bank Loan EMI Calculator (Home, Auto & Personal)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/emi
- Programmatic Amounts: https://nepalicalc.com/emi/5-lakh-loan-emi-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/10-lakh-loan-emi-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/20-lakh-loan-emi-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/50-lakh-loan-emi-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/emi/1-crore-loan-emi-nepal
- Formula: EMI = [P × r × (1 + r)^n] / [(1 + r)^n - 1]

### 1.3 Bank Fixed Deposit (FD) & Local Byaj Calculator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/interest
- Programmatic Scenarios: https://nepalicalc.com/interest/1-lakh-fixed-deposit-interest-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/interest/5-lakh-fixed-deposit-interest-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/interest/10-lakh-fixed-deposit-interest-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/interest/sayakada-2-byaj-hisab-nepal
- FD Parameters: Average 7.00% p.a. quarterly compounding; 5% mandatory government TDS on interest earnings.
- Local Lending: Sayakada 1.5 (18% p.a.), Sayakada 2 (24% p.a.), Sayakada 3 (36% p.a.). Note: Muluki Civil Code 2074 Section 478 caps legal interest at 10% per annum.

### 1.4 Foreign Remittance In-Hand Net
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/remittance-calculator
- Corridors: UAE (AED), Qatar (QAR), Saudi Arabia (SAR), Kuwait (KWD), Malaysia (MYR), South Korea (KRW), Japan (JPY), USA (USD), Australia (AUD), UK (GBP), Eurozone (EUR), India (INR).
- Channels: Direct Bank Account Deposit (+1% special remittance bonus interest in Nepal), eSewa/Khalti wallet transfer, cash pickup.

### 1.5 NRB Official Foreign Exchange Converter
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/forex
- Programmatic Slugs: https://nepalicalc.com/forex/1000-aed-to-npr, https://nepalicalc.com/forex/1000-qar-to-npr, https://nepalicalc.com/forex/100-usd-to-npr, https://nepalicalc.com/forex/1000-myr-to-npr, https://nepalicalc.com/forex/10000-jpy-to-npr
- Data: Live Nepal Rastra Bank foreign currency buying/selling mid-rates.

### 1.6 Village Sahu Byaj (Sayakada Interest & Saundh)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/village-interest
- Features: Exact calendar day calculations between two Bikram Sambat dates; simple interest vs yearly compounding (साँवामा ब्याज गाभ्ने हिसाब).

### 1.7 Inflation & Purchasing Power Loss
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/inflation
- Benchmark: Nepal CPI Inflation index over 1 to 30 years.

### 1.8 Nepali Number to Words Converter (लाख, करोड, अर्ब)

### 1.9 Bank Loan Eligibility & DSTI Borrowing Limit
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/loan-eligibility
- Rule: Verifies monthly family income against Nepal Rastra Bank 50% Debt-Service-to-Income (DSTI) rule.

### 1.10 EPF, CIT & Pension Retirement Corpus
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/pension

### 1.11 Bank Fixed Deposit vs Debenture Yield Comparison
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/fd-vs-debenture

### 1.12 Foreign Employment & Manpower Cost Estimator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/foreign-employment

### 1.13 CAGR & Compound Growth Calculator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/cagr
- Formula: CAGR = (Final Value / Initial Value)^(1 / Years) - 1.

### 1.14 Nepal Home Loan & NRB LTV Calculator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/nepal-home-loan

### 1.15 Savings Goal & Target Wealth Planner
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/savings-goal
- Computes required monthly deposit to achieve a target corpus (e.g. NPR 50 Lakh or 1 Crore) in a specified timeframe.

## 2. Tax, Salary, Customs & Labour Law (11 Tools)

### 2.1 Salary Income Tax (FY 2083/84)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/tax, https://nepalicalc.com/salary
- Programmatic Slugs (45 Granular Brackets): From NPR 15k/mo to 10 Lakh/mo (`/tax/tax-on-30000-salary-nepal`, `/tax/tax-on-75000-salary-nepal`, etc.).
- Tax Slabs:
  - 1% on first 10,00,000 (0% SST if registered in SSF)
  - 10% on next 5,00,000 (10L - 15L)
  - 20% on next 10,00,000 (15L - 25L)
  - 27% on next 15,00,000 (25L - 40L)
  - 29% on amount exceeding 40,00,000
- Maximum Allowable Deductions: EPF/CIT/SSF (up to 5L or 1/3 of salary), Life Insurance (40k), Medical Insurance (20k), Female Salaried Rebate (10%).

### 2.2 TDS & Withholding Tax (Income Tax Act 2058)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/tds
- Programmatic Rates: https://nepalicalc.com/tds/house-rent-tds-rate-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/tds/consultancy-service-tds-rate-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/tds/transportation-freight-tds-rate-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/tds/contract-payment-tds-section-89-nepal
- Statutory Rates: House rent (10%), Consultancy (1.5% with VAT invoice / 15% PAN), Freight (2.5%), Contracts > 50k (1.5%), Bank Interest (5%), NEPSE Dividends (5%).

### 2.3 Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) Baggage & Customs Duty
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage
- Programmatic Sub-pages: https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/gold-from-dubai-to-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/gold-from-qatar-to-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/gold-from-saudi-arabia-to-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/gold-from-usa-to-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/gold-from-australia-to-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/tv-from-dubai-to-nepal-customs, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/iphone-from-dubai-to-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/liquor-limit-tia-airport, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/second-laptop-customs-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage/foreign-currency-cash-limit-nepal
- Authority: झिटिगुन्टा आदेश २०८३/८४
- Duty-Free Allowances:
  - Gold Ornaments: 50g free for women, 25g free for men. Next 100g excess: NPR 1,050/g; 100g-200g excess: NPR 1,250/g. Beyond +200g liable to seizure.
  - Raw Gold (Bullion/Biscuit): 0g free. Strictly prohibited in personal luggage; subject to immediate airport confiscation.
  - Phones: 1 phone free for all. 2 phones free for migrant workers with 6+ mo labor permit and SSF. Extra phone ~NPR 10k duty for MDMS.
  - TVs: 1 TV up to 32" 100% free for 12+ mo migrant workers with SSF. 43" (NPR 9,500), 55" (NPR 19,500).
  - Alcohol: Strictly 1 bottle (max 1 Liter) free. Excess cannot be taxed; it is confiscated.
  - Cash: Up to USD $5,000 equivalent unhindered; >$5,000 requires mandatory customs declaration form.

### 2.4 Mobile Phone MDMS & Customs Duty
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/customs
- Rule: Nepal Telecommunications Authority (NTA) MDMS white-listing requirements and airport customs clearance.

### 2.5 Schedule 2 Tax Depreciation (WDV Pool A to E)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/depreciation
- Slabs: Block A (5%), Block B (25%), Block C (20%), Block D (15%), Block E (Straight line). 3-tier timing rule (3/3, 2/3, 1/3) and 7% repairs cap.

### 2.6 Corporate & Advance Tax (Section 94)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/corporate-tax
- Slabs: Standard 25% (Banks 30%, Manufacturing 20%). Advance instalments: Poush 40%, Chaitra 70%, Ashadh 100%.

### 2.7 13% VAT & Service Charge Calculator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/vat
- Features: Forward VAT addition (13%) and reverse VAT extraction (Gross / 1.13).

### 2.8 Gratuity Calculator (Labour Act 2074)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/gratuity
- Formula: 8.33% of monthly basic remuneration deposited into SSF.

### 2.9 Overtime (OT) Pay Calculator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/overtime
- Formula: 1.5 times basic hourly rate (Basic Monthly Salary / 208 hours × 1.5).

### 2.10 House Rent Tax & Local Ward Municipality Slabs
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/rent-tax
- Rule: 10% flat rate paid to local Ward Office.

### 2.11 How Much Gold Can You Bring to Nepal
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/how-much-gold-can-you-bring-to-nepal
- Complete passenger customs guidelines for jewelry, raw gold, and silver.

## 3. Real Estate, Land Measurement & Municipal Property (4 Tools + 49 Slugs)

### 3.1 Land Area & Valuation Converter (Ropani ⇄ Bigha ⇄ Sq Ft)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/land
- Programmatic Pages (49 Slugs): `/land/ropani-to-aana`, `/land/aana-to-sqft`, `/land/bigha-to-sqft`, `/land/daam-to-sqft`, `/land/haat-to-feet`, etc.
- Standards:
  - 1 Ropani = 16 Aana = 64 Paisa = 256 Daam = 5,476 Sq Ft = 508.74 Sq Meters
  - 1 Bigha = 20 Kattha = 400 Dhur = 72,900 Sq Ft = 6,772.63 Sq Meters

### 3.2 Land Malpot Registration & Capital Gains Tax (CGT)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/malpot
- Programmatic Slabs: https://nepalicalc.com/malpot/land-registration-tax-kathmandu-valley, https://nepalicalc.com/malpot/land-registration-tax-lalitpur, https://nepalicalc.com/malpot/land-registration-charges-terai-municipalities, https://nepalicalc.com/malpot/capital-gains-tax-on-land-sale-nepal, https://nepalicalc.com/malpot/female-ownership-land-rebate-nepal
- Registration Rates: 5.0% in Metros (+ 0.5% local tax); 4.5% in Terai municipalities; 2.0% in Rural Municipalities.
- Female Discount: Mandatory 25% concession on registration fee.
- Seller CGT: 5% (>5 years) or 7.5% (≤5 years).

### 3.3 Land Road Deduction (Bato Katta)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/bato-katta
- Features: Calculates road sacrifice area for 10ft, 13ft, 16ft, 20ft roads and effective usable price per Aana.

### 3.4 Annual Municipal Property Tax (Ghar Jagga Kar)
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/property-tax
- Slabs: Local municipality progressive land and building valuation brackets.

## 4. NEPSE Stocks, Shares, IPO & Mutual Funds (5 Tools + 26 Slugs)

### 4.1 SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) Mutual Fund Calculator
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/sip
- Programmatic Goals (26 Slugs): `/sip/sip-calculator-1000-per-month`, `/sip/sip-calculator-5000-per-month`, `/sip/sip-calculator-50-lakh-corpus-goal`, `/sip/sip-calculator-1-crore-wealth-goal`
- Expected Return: 12% to 15% CAGR historical open-ended mutual fund benchmarks.

### 4.2 NEPSE Share Trading Profit & Broker Commission
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/nepse
- SEBON Broker Commission: 0.40% (≤50k), 0.37% (50k-5L), 0.34% (5L-20L), 0.30% (20L-1Cr), 0.27% (>1Cr). SEBON fee: 0.015%. DP charge: NPR 25. CGT: 5% (holding > 365 days) or 7.5% (≤ 365 days).

### 4.3 NEPSE WACC & Weighted Average Cost
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/nepse-wacc
- Compliant with MeroShare book-closure weighted average cost calculation.

### 4.4 NEPSE Right Share & Bonus Share Price Adjustment
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/right-share
- Formulas:
  - Adjusted Price (Bonus) = Previous Closing / (1 + Bonus%)
  - Adjusted Price (Right) = [Previous Closing + (Right Ratio × 100)] / (1 + Right Ratio)

### 4.5 IPO Allotment & Lottery Probability
- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/ipo-allotment
- Features: Calculates CDS & Clearing lottery allotment chances based on issue shares and total applicants.

- URL: https://nepalicalc.com/statistics-calculator
- Computes mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, and roots of ax² + bx + c = 0.
